findings.detail: records without boot_id (all pre-#189 claims) fail _boot_matches → _owner_alive False → _reap_orphan returns True at the boot gate → claim DELETED without any signal. Two harms: (a) live trees leak (never reaped, never retried); (b) a LIVE owner's exclusion marker is dropped, so a new host can claim the same dispatch (double-execution risk, conditional on claim-presence being the exclusion as the gate implies). Same effect when current_boot_id() fails (''). Tellingly, the author's own no-start-time keep-branch (return not _running_group_member) is UNREACHABLE for old records because the boot gate fires first — reads as oversight, not decision.
findings.fix: missing recorded boot_id (or unknown current boot) → keep claim (return False), not delete; optionally version records for an explicit migration path
findings.title: pre-#189 claims deleted unreaped: live-tree leak + live-owner exclusion drop on upgrade-with-inflight
